From 9 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 8, to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9, and again from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. Monday and Tuesday, Oct. 12-13, two lanes of eastbound I-90 will close between Lakemont Boulevard Southeast and East Sunset Way/Highlands Drive NE for pavement repair. 

At least one lane will remain open each night. Delays are possible through the work zone.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 from I-90 (milepost 11.5) to Northeast Fourth Street (milepost 13.6) will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 16.

Up to four lanes of southbound I-405 from Northeast Eighth Street (milepost 14) to milepost 12 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 16.

The northbound I-405 off-ramp to eastbound I-90 will be closed nightly from 10:30 p.m. – 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 16. A signed detour will be in place.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard Southeast will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 16. A signed detour will be in place.

The southbound I-405 off-ramp to eastbound I-90 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. – 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 16. A signed detour will be in place.
Flaggers will control traffic on the southbound I-405 off-ramp to Coal Creek Parkway from 8 to 8:30 a.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, for utility work.

The northbound I-405 off-ramps to Northeast Fourth Street / Northeast Eighth Street will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. – 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 16. A signed detour will be in place.

Maintenance crews will intermittently close a mile of the tolled lanes on northbound I-405 between Bellevue and Lynwood between 9 p.m. and 5 a.m. nightly for toll equipment maintenance work. The work will start near Southeast 8th Street in Bellevue on the evening of Monday, Oct. 12 and then proceed north each night until reaching the end of the tolled lanes near I-5 in Lynnwood on the morning of Friday, Oct. 16. Only a mile of the lanes will be closed at a time.
The left lane of northbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, to 5 a.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, near 236th Street Southeast (milepost 26) for maintenance.
The left lane of northbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, to 5 a.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, near 216th Street Southeast (milepost 28) for maintenance.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to westbound SR 522 will be closed nightly from 11:59 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 12 to Wednesday morning, Oct. 14.
The northbound and southbound SR 527 on-ramps to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. to 4:30 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 12 to Wednesday morning, Oct. 14.
The Northeast 160th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 12 to Friday morning, Oct. 16.
The right lane of the northbound I-405/Northeast 160th Street off-ramp to eastbound SR 522 will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 12 to Saturday morning, Oct. 17.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to SR 527 will be closed nightly from 11:59 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 12 to Wednesday morning, Oct. 14.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 between Northeast 195th Street (milepost 24.8) and Damson Road (milepost 29.0) will be closed nightly from 11:30 p.m. to 4:30 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 12 to Wednesday morning, Oct. 14.
The left lane of southbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 16, near 216th Street Southeast (milepost 27) for maintenance.

Two lanes of eastbound SR 522 between Campus Way Northeast (milepost 10.4) and I-405 (milepost 11.4) will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. to 4:30 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 12 to Wednesday morning, Oct. 14.
Northbound and southbound SR 203 traffic will alternate from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, near the King-Snohomish county line (milepost 18) for maintenance.
From 8 a.m. Monday, Oct. 12 to noon Friday, Oct. 16, the northbound Interstate 5 SeaTac rest area will close for maintenance.
The Seatac Rest Area is closed until further notice for routine maintenance.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Oct. 12, through Thursday morning, Oct. 15, the northbound I-5 on- and off-ramps at South 272nd Street will close for crack sealing and pavement repair. Signed detours will be available.

Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 between Northeast 128th Street (milepost 21.43) and SR 522 (milepost 23.5) will be closed nightly from 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 12 to Friday morning, Oct. 16.
The Northeast 128th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will close from 11:59 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 13, to 4:30 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, for maintenance.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 128th Street will close from 11:59 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 13, to 4:30 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, for maintenance.
The left two lanes of northbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 13, to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, between Northeast 110th and 116th streets (milepost 19-20) for maintenance.

The right lane on northbound and southbound SR 161 will close during the day Sunday through Thursday for about six weeks for ongoing fish passage construction. 

From 6 a.m. to 3 p.m., one lane of southbound SR 161 will close.

From 9 p.m. to 5 p.m., one lane of northbound SR 161 will close.

People traveling through the area during these times should expect delays, particularly during peak travel times.
From 10 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, until 1 a.m. Friday, Oct. 16, the southbound I-5 exit to Port of Tacoma Road will close for maintenance. Travelers will follow alternate routes during the closure.

Until further notice, SR 161 is reduced to one lane in each direction between 36th Street East and Dechaux Road East on North Hill due to slide activity. Travelers can expect shifted lanes and congestion approaching North Hill.

From 8 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, through 4 a.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, two lanes of northbound SR 167 will close between Hardie Avenue SW and SR 99 for pavement repair. Delays are possible through the work zone.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from Sunset Boulevard North / SR 900 (milepost 5.2) to Talbot Road South / SR 515 (milepost 3) will be closed nightly from 10:30 p.m. – 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 16.

Up to two lanes of northbound I-405 from Northeast 44th Street (milepost 7) to 112th Avenue Southeast / Lake Washington Boulevard Southeast (milepost 9) will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 16.

The Northeast 44th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Wednesday, Oct. 14. A signed detour will be in place.

The southbound I-405 off-ramp to Talbot Road South / SR 515 will be closed nightly from 10:30 p.m. –5 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Friday, Oct. 16. A signed detour will be in place.

From 10 to 11:30 p.m. on Wednesday and Thursday nights, Oct. 14-15, three lanes of northbound I-5 will close between NE Ravenna Boulevard and NE 92nd Street for pavement repair. Delays are possible through the work zone.

From 12:01 to 12:30 a.m. on Thursday and Friday nights, Oct. 15-16, two right lanes of northbound I-5 will close between Northeast Ravenna Boulevard and Northeast 117th Street for pavement repair. Delays are possible through the work zone.
From 1 to 3 a.m. on Tuesday morning, Oct. 13, two lanes of northbound I-5 will close between Northeast 45th and 77th streets for pavement repair. Delays are possible through the work zone.

From 11 p.m. to 3:30 a.m. nightly Wednesday, Oct. 14, until Friday morning, Oct. 16, two lanes of southbound I-5 will close between Northeast 117th and 65th streets for pavement repair. Delays are possible through the work zone.
The express lanes are northbound-only 24 hours a day through the end of 2026 due to lane reductions for construction on the northbound I-5 Ship Canal Bridge.

Monday, Oct. 12, until the morning of Friday, Oct. 16 - The eastbound SR 520 off-ramp to Montlake Boulevard in Seattle will close for construction nightly beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. The ramp will reopen at 6 a.m. each of the following mornings. During these closures, all traffic from I-5 that enters eastbound SR 520 will pay the bridge toll. Those who do not want to pay the toll or who need to access Montlake Boulevard from I-5 must use alternate routes.
From 10 to 11:30 p.m. on Wednesday and Thursday nights, Oct. 14-15, the northbound I-5 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will close for pavement repair. Signed detours will be available.

Monday, Oct. 5, on most weeknights until Friday, Oct. 23 - The westbound SR 520 off-ramp to northbound I-5 and East Roanoke Street will close for construction nightly beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. The ramp will reopen at 6 a.m. each of the following mornings. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic that remains on westbound SR 520 past the Montlake and Lake Washington boulevard exits will detour to southbound I-5.
Sound Transit crews will close the northbound I-5 off-ramp to Northeast 130th Street in Seattle from 10 p.m. Friday, Oct. 9, until 5 a.m. Monday, Oct. 19.
From 3 to 3:30 a.m. on Tuesday and Wednesday morning, Oct. 13-14, the southbound I-5 on-ramp from Northeast 85th Street will close for pavement repair. Signed detours will be available.
From 10 to 11:30 p.m. on Wednesday and Thursday nights, Oct. 14-15, the northbound I-5 on-ramp from Northeast 70th Street will close for pavement repair. Signed detours will be available.

From 11 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, to 3:30 a.m. Friday, Oct. 16, two lanes of northbound I-5 will close between Northeast 45th and 65th streets for pavement repair. Delays are possible through the work zone.

Sound Transit crews will close the right lane of northbound I-5 between North 185th and North 200th streets from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Oct. 12, until Wednesday morning, Oct. 14. The northbound I-5 off-ramp to eastbound SR 104 also will close at the same time

From 3 to 4:30 a.m. on Tuesday and Wednesday mornings, Oct. 13-14, three right lanes of southbound I-5 will close between Northeast 195th and 145th streets for pavement repair. Delays are possible through the work zone.
From 3 to 4:30 a.m. on Tuesday and Wednesday mornings, Oct. 13-14, the Northeast 175th Street on-ramp to southbound I-5 will close for pavement repair. Signed detours will be available.

From 3 to 4:30 a.m. on Tuesday and Wednesday mornings, Oct. 13-14, the southbound I-5 on-ramp from the King County Metro North bus base will close for pavement repair. Signed detours will be available.

The southbound I-5 off-ramp to Northeast 145th Street/SR 523 will close from 11 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 13, to 3 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, for utility work. The right lane of southbound I-5 will close at the same time.
Eastbound and westbound US 2 will alternate from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Monday, Oct. 12, through Friday morning, Oct. 16, east of Money Creek Campground (milepost 47-48) for utility work.

Daily from 7 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. beginning Tuesday, Oct. 13 to 2:30 p.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, US 2 traffic will alternate with flaggers at Sky Lane (milepost 49) for maintenance. This work may also need to occur on Tuesday, Oct. 20 and Wednesday, Oct. 21.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly, Wednesday, Oct. 14, through Friday morning, Oct. 16, one lane of SR 202 will close between Tokul Creek and SE 46th Street for pavement repair. Flaggers will alternate traffic through the work zone.
The left two lanes of eastbound I-90 will close from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 17, between SR 18 and Southeast North Bend Way (milepost 26-27) for maintenance.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from SR 181 (milepost 1) to I-5 (milepost 0) will be closed nightly from 9:30 p.m. – 4:30 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Wednesday, Oct. 14.

Daily from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. beginning Tuesday, Oct. 13 to 1 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, one left lane of northbound State Route 599 from Interstate 5 to South 133rd Street (milepost 0) will close for maintenance.
Northbound SR 599 will be reduced to one lane from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Tuesday and Wednesday, Oct. 13-14, from I-5 to South 133rd Street for maintenance.

The southbound SR 599/SR 99 direct acesss ramp to westbound international Boulevard will close from 8 a.m. to noon Friday, Oct. 16. People may detour to South 116th Way and proceed to International Bouelvard.

The southbound I-405 HOV off-ramp to northbound I-5 will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 4:15 a.m., starting the night of Monday, Oct. 12 to the morning of Wednesday, Oct. 14. A signed detour will be in place.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly, Wednesday, Oct. 14, through Friday morning, Oct. 16, one lane of SR 202 will close between Northeast 143rd Street and 156th Avenue NE for pavement repairs. Flaggers will alternate traffic through the work zone.
The left lane of northbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 16, near Damson Road (milepost 29) for maintenance.
The left lane of southbound I-405 will close from 9 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 15, to 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 16, near Damson Road (milepost 29) for maintenance.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.

Up to two general-purpose lanes of westbound SR 522 between I-405 (milepost 11.6) and Campus Way Northeast (milepost 10.6) will be closed nightly from 9:30 p.m. to 4:30 a.m. starting Monday night, Oct. 12 to Friday morning, Oct. 16.

From 10 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 13 to 4 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, the left lane of northbound Interstate 5 from the Ebey Slough Bridge to 88th Street Northeast (milepost 200) will close for maintenance work.

From 10 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 13 to 4 a.m. Wednesday, Oct. 14, the left lane of northbound Interstate 5 from the Ebey Slough Bridge to 88th Street Northeast (milepost 199) will close for maintenance work.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings crews will alternate traffic with flaggers and pilot cars in sections between a nearly 11-mile stretch of SR 203, just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20).

Beginning Monday, Sept. 21 until 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. (except Saturdays), State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from US 2 to Main Street (milepost 24) for utilities.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings beginning Monday, July 27, one lane of State Route 203 will be closed for a paving project between just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20). Flaggers and pilot cars will direct alternating traffic through the remaining open lane.

Nightly, from 9 p.m. until 7 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings, contractor crews will alternate traffic through the intersections of State Route 525 in Mukilteo between Paine Field and the Mukilteo Ferry Terminal for pedestrian upgrades. Pedestrians may need to use local roads to detour around the work zone.
Lowell-Snohomish River Road will alternate traffic near SR 9 beginning Wednesday, Sept. 30.
Eastbound and westbound SR 96 will alternate from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily Monday, Oct. 12, through Friday, Oct. 16, near Lark Dairy Farm (milepost 6) for utility work.
